name: Didaco
bio: Florentine actor whom Wilde met at Genoa on his journey from the Riviera to Gland in late February 1899, and with whom he spent three days. Wilde described him to Reginald Turner as 'a beautiful young actor, a Florentine, whom I wildly loved', bearing 'the strange name of Didaco' and 'the look of Romeo, without Romeo's sadness'. No surname, age, dates or further trace appear in the letter, and nothing else about him was found in the pages read.
bio_note: Sole source: Wilde to Reginald Turner, postmark 20 March 1899, Complete Letters (2000), p. 1132 (the letter ends at p. 1133 with no further mention of him). The journey is fixed by the correspondence: Wilde left Nice for Switzerland 'via Genoa' on 25 February 1899 and wrote from Gland of his 'arrival from Genoa yesterday' (to Ross, [c. 1 March 1899], p. 1127). Frankel (2017, p. 248) retells the meeting and confirms Genoa over Naples.
